headline: Virgil's pinch-hit slam caps four-run ninth rally
recap: The Phillies trailed the San Francisco Giants 3-1 entering the bottom of the ninth before scoring four runs to win 5-3 at Veterans Stadium. Pinch-hitter Alejandro Sanchez made the first out, but Garry Maddox singled, and the Giants committed back-to-back errors, a throwing error by shortstop Johnnie LeMaster and a fielding error by third baseman Darrell Evans, that loaded the bases with two outs. Tony Perez, pinch-hitting for reliever Ron Reed, struck out, but Ozzie Virgil Jr., batting for Joe Morgan, hit a grand slam off Gary Lavelle to end it.

Phillies starter John Denny allowed two runs over seven innings, striking out four and walking one. Giants starter Renie Martin worked six and one-third innings and gave up one run, Morgan's solo home run in the first, his 12th of the season, while striking out four and walking four.

Jeffrey Leonard drove in all three Giants runs, singling home two in the seventh and doubling home Evans in the ninth to put San Francisco ahead 3-1. Reed worked the final two innings for the Phillies and picked up the win; Lavelle, who had retired the first six Phillies batters he faced, took the loss after Maddox's one-out single opened the Phillies' ninth-inning rally.
